ops.body: Codex Stage-4 review: the headless-rotation fix (InstallSyncedCredential ErrUnavailable→file-fallback, commit 24c05f6) routes headless sync-install rotations through writeCredCAS, which carries this same irreducible read→write TOCTOU (usage.go:105). Phase-1 FIX C already makes the CAS re-read ABORT on an owned blob, so only the microsecond gap between the CAS compare and the write remains — same residual this task tracks, now applicable to headless peer rotation-installs. NOT a new class; not reverting (the alternative is permanent headless-peer staleness). Zero impact on the user's GUI Macs (keychain reads succeed → fallback never fires). Coverage gap noted by codex: no end-to-end unavailable→fallback→readable→cleanup lifecycle test — low value (tests the irreducible-race boundary).
